attempted_claim: Let W* be the fixed Mazur-type contractible Stein cork with Stein structure J0 given by diagram D*, let tau be its boundary involution, J1=tau*J0, and xi0, xi1 the induced contact structures on Y=partial W*. Then xi0 and xi1 are non-isotopic tight contact structures with d3(xi1)!=d3(xi0) and distinct Heegaard Floer contact classes c+(xi0)!=c+(xi1) in HF+(-Y), so J0 and J1 are non-homotopic Stein structures and tau does not extend as a contactomorphism.
